arabic text: AY MERE AKHI ABBAS
english translation text: O MY BROTHER ABBAS!

arabic text: (FARYAD SUNO MERI, IK BAAR MUJHE BHAAYI, KEHKAR TO BULA GHAZI)
english translation text: LISTEN TO MY PLEA! JUST ONCE, CALL ME 'BROTHER' O GHAZI!

arabic text: BACHPAN ME TERA JHULA, HAATHON SE JHULAAYA THA
english translation text: WHEN YOU WERE A CHILD, WITH MY OWN HANDS DID I SWING YOUR CRADLE

arabic text: HATHON KO TERE LEKAR, CHALNA BHI SIKHAAYA THA
english translation text: AND TAKING YOUR HAND IN MINE, I SHOWED YOU HOW TO WALK

arabic text: AB IN HATHON SE ME, KISTARHA UTHAAUGA, BIN BAAZU YE LAASH TERI
english translation text: NOW PRAY! HOW WITH THESE SAME HANDS AM I TO LIFT THIS, YOUR CORPSE?

arabic text: AANKHO(N) KA DIYA TUM HO, KHALIQ KI ATA TUM HO
english translation text: YOU ARE THE LANTERN OF OUR EYES; YOU ARE THE CREATOR’S GIFT

arabic text: BABA NE JO MAANGI THI, RABSE WO DUA TUM HO
english translation text: YOU ARE THE FRUIT OF OUR FATHER’S PRAYER

arabic text: SAQQAYE SAKINA HO, ZAINAB KI RIDA TUM HO, TUM HI HO KAMAR MERI
english translation text: YOU ARE THE QUENCHER OF SAKINA’S THIRST; YOU ARE ZAYNAB’S VEIL; YOU ARE MY BACKBONE

arabic text: TEERO(N) KE MUSALLE PAR, SAR KO MEI KATAAWUNGA
english translation text: SOON, UPON A BED OF ARROWS, SHALL I SACRIFICE MY HEAD

arabic text: KYA DEKH SAKOGE TUM, MEI KHU(N) MEI NAHAWUNGA
english translation text: WILL YOU BE ABLE TO ENDURE THAT SIGHT, WHEN I’LL BE BATHED IN BLOOD

arabic text: ZAKHMI MERE SINE SE, HAR KHUN KE QATRE SE, AWAAZ YE AAYENGI
english translation text: AND FROM MY WOUNDED CHEST, AND FROM EVERY DROP OF BLOOD, SHALL ARISE THIS VOICE:

arabic text: AKBAR KA KALEJA HAI, NAZRO(N) MEI MERE BHAYYA
english translation text: SOON SHALL I, WITH MY OWN EYES, SEE AKBAR’S HEART, O BROTHER!

arabic text: ASGHAR KA LAHU HOGA, HAATHO(N) MEI MERE BHAYYA
english translation text: AND SOON SHALL MY HANDS, WITH ASGHAR’S BLOOD, BE COVERED, O BROTHER!

arabic text: MAY KISKO PUKARUNGA, MAY KISKO SADA DUNGA, BATLAADO MERE GHAZI
english translation text: WHO WILL I CALL? TO WHOM WILL I CRY OUT? TELL ME O GHAZI!

arabic text: SUNTEHO SAKINA KE, LAB PAR HAI FUGHAA(N) BHAI,
english translation text: CAN YOU HEAR THE SORROWFUL CRY ON SAKINA’S LIPS?

arabic text: LOT AAO MERE AMMU, PAANI NAHI MANGUNGI
english translation text: 'RETURN O MY UNCLE, I SHALL NOT SEEK WATER'

arabic text: AB RUT NA JAAWO TUM, ITNA TO ZARA SOCHO, MARJAAYEGI WO BACHI
english translation text: DO NOT TURN AWAY, THINK HOW THE LITTLE GIRL WILL DIE!

arabic text: MAUT AAYENGI ZINDAA(N) MEI, MASOOM SAKINA KO
english translation text: IN THE DUNGEONS, SHALL DEATH REACH THE INNOCENT SAKINA

arabic text: RO RO KE SADA DEGI, AMMU MERE AJAAWO
english translation text: WEEPING, SHALL SHE CALL OUT 'COME MY UNCLE!'

arabic text: JAAN(N) APNI GAWAKAR WO PHIR SHAM KE ZINDA(N) SE, NA LOT KE AAEGI
english translation text: THEN NEVER SHALL SHE RETURN, LOSING HER LIFE IN THE DUNGEONS OF SYRIA

arabic text: RUKH KARKE NAJAF KA PHIR GHAZI NE KAHA BABA
english translation text: THEN TURNING TO NAJAF, SAID ABBAS 'O FATHER!'

arabic text: AB PAAS NAHI BAAZU, MAY KYA KARU BABA
english translation text: O FATHER! I AM LEFT WITH NO ARMS, WHAT I AM TO DO?

arabic text: MAULA HAI AKELA AB, KARBAL ME BACHI HAI BAS, SHABBIR KI TANHAYI
english translation text: MY MASTER IS NOW ALONE, NOTHING REMAINS IN KARBALA, EXCEPT SHABBIR’S LONELINESS

arabic text: SUNKAR YE SADA SHEH KI, ABBAS KA TAN TARPA
english translation text: HEARING THIS CALL OF THE KING (IMAM), ABBAS’S BODY TREMBLED

arabic text: JALTI HUWI RETI PAR GHAZI KA BADAN LARZA
english translation text: ON THE BURNING SANDS, ABBAS’S BODY TREMBLED

arabic text: KAESE MERE AAQA MAY, JAAU(N) DARE KHAIME PAR, JAB PAAS NAHI PAANI
english translation text: HOW MY MASTER, CAN I GO TO CAMP, WHEN I DO NOT HAVE ANY WATER?

arabic text: AAQA MAY SUE KHAIMA, HARGIZ NAHI JAAUNGA
english translation text: MASTER, NEVER TOWARDS THE CAMP SHALL I EVER RETURN…

arabic text: MAY KAISE SAKINA KO, MU(N) APNA DIKHAUNGA
english translation text: PRAY! HOW CAN I FACE SAKINA?

arabic text: AB ROZE QAYAMAT TAK, DARYA KE KINAARE SE, UTHWAANA NA LAASH MERI
english translation text: AND NEVER TILL JUDGEMENT COME, FROM THE RIVERBANKS, SHOULD ANYONE CARRY MY CORPSE

arabic text: KARBAL ME 'TEJANI' THI SHABBIR KI YE HAALAT
english translation text: O TEJANI, THIS WAS THE STATE OF SHABBIR ON THE DUNES OF KARBALA

arabic text: IK BAAR KAHO BHAAYI, PURI HO MERI HASRAT
english translation text: JUST ONCE SAY 'BROTHER' SO MY LIFELONG DESIRE BE FULFILLED

arabic text: ABBAS KE HOTO(N)SE, EK BAAR SADA AAI, SHABBIR MERE BHAYI
english translation text: AND LO! FROM THE LIPS OF ABBAS, ROSE THE VOICE… 'SHABBIR, MY BROTHER!'
